content: mosh: mosh-server spawned per session over SSH bootstrap, listens UDP, AES-128 key returned to client; server runs full terminal emulator (Terminal::Display) and State Synchronization Protocol sends screen state DIFFS not byte stream; roaming + intermittent connectivity native; predictive local echo client-side; cost: implementing a VT emulator is a large surface (mosh has its own parser); no scrollback by design (only current screen). Trade-off vs byte-replay: precise reattach for full-screen apps, at cost of full server-side emulation.
